description: Defines the IListRef class and related iterator and tag dispatch mechanisms for handling lists in PyTorch's ATen library. It wraps boxed and unboxed API containers to optimize API calls and facilitate interoperability between different PyTorch APIs.

classes.name: IListRef
classes.description: A view type that wraps around boxed and unboxed list containers, providing a unified API for list operations without ownership.

classes.name: IListRefIterator
classes.description: An iterator class that wraps container-specific iterators for IListRef, supporting bidirectional iteration.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the list.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the list.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the list.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns the first element of the list.

methods.name: materialize
methods.description: Converts IListRef to a Materialized list (vector) for repeated or random access.

methods.name: isUnboxed
methods.description: Checks if the list is unboxed.

methods.name: isBoxed
methods.description: Checks if the list is boxed.

methods.name: isMaterialized
methods.description: Checks if the list is materialized.
